summary.text: Dillan Vancil is the Republican nominee for Illinois's 17th District. He is a former railroad engineer and the founder of the Dame Fine Coffee shop chain in west-central Illinois, and has served on the West Central school board. He won the March 2026 Republican primary over Carroll County Board Chair Julie Bickelhaupt and describes his campaign as focused on small business, energy, and affordability.

paragraphs.text: Born in Illinois; graduated from West-Central High School, according to his questionnaire answers to Tri States Public Radio, which listed his age as 33 as of March 17, 2026.
Worked as a railroad engineer before becoming a business owner, according to NPR Illinois.

Founder and CEO of Dame Fine Coffee, a chain of coffee shops in west-central Illinois and eastern Iowa (NPR Illinois reported seven shops in August 2025); the name is an acronym of his family members' first names.
Served on the West Central School Board (former vice president), and lists membership on the Eagleview Community Health board and the Monmouth Chamber of Commerce board.
Lives west of Monmouth, Illinois, according to NPR Illinois.
Won the March 17, 2026 Republican primary for the 17th District with 58.4% of the vote over Julie Bickelhaupt (41.6%).
Told NPR Illinois he entered the race because he wants to make it easier to start and grow small businesses.
